_comment: Keep-out zones for rollout/safety.py. Axis-aligned boxes in ROBOT FRAME metres,
the same frame as WORKSPACE_MIN/MAX in robot/cone_e.py.
Starts EMPTY on purpose: a wrong zone is worse than no zone, because it rejects
legitimate motion and looks like the policy failing. Measure a real one before
adding it -- robot/test_boundaries.py EXPLORE mode prints live EE positions and
snapshots them on ENTER, so drive the arm around the volume you want forbidden
Sanity-check any zone against the demo envelope before use:
observed action+state range over all tasks was
A zone overlapping that range will fire during normal operation.
max_step_m bounds the jump between consecutive commanded targets. The demo
maximum over 360,863 transitions at 30 Hz was 29.93 mm, so 40 mm cannot trigger
on normal motion -- only on a genuine runaway.
